description: Returns what changed in each Gemmein release newer than `since` (a Gemmein version, e.g. "0.22.1"), or the last three when `since` is left out: each change as was → now, with the error codes it added or removed. Useful when knowledge of Gemmein may be older than the installed release (training data, or a guide read weeks ago). The feed is bundled with this server, offline; every release in full is at https://docs.gemmein.com/changes.txt. Where the feed and older knowledge differ, the feed is current.

since.description: the Gemmein version you knew, e.g. 0.22.1 — returns every release after it; leave out for the last three

name: changes
title: What changed
